correctness.rationale: Right Leibniz multiplication [e_i,e_1]=e_(i+1) makes a derivation D uniquely determined by n coefficients D(e_1). In R_n=K[t]/(t^n), its matrix is the linear operator a_1(1+t∂_t)+M_h. For a_1=0, nullity equals t-order of h, giving geometric-count terms. If a_1≠0 and n<p, all diagonal entries a_1,2a_1,...,na_1 are invertible. For n>=p, strip invertible terminal length n−p floor(n/p); normalize a unit u(t) by setting its degrees divisible by p to zero and recursively solve a_1tu′=(b(t^p)−h)u; conjugation leaves p residue blocks, only the block with exponent p−1 possibly singular, with nullity min(ord_s b,m), m=floor(n/p). Fresh resonance coordinates b_1,...,b_(m−1) are triangular, uniformly distributed, yielding exactly the displayed formula with total q^n and no invertible derivations when n>=p. Independent exhaustive finite-field Gaussian elimination for p=2 n<=7, p=3 n<=6, p=5 n<=5 matches all histograms. Finite checks cannot establish the universal field/dimension case.
